text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Even if Opera O-chan is strong! Even if Doto-chan is chasing after me!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I will not lose.
Hyaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road!
It's Narita Top Road!
She magnificently clinches the first battle of the Autumn Big Four showdown!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A resilience she didn't have last year!
Just what on earth could have spurred her
to grow this much!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was likely—a clash with a rival.
It was a resounding victory, leaving no room for doubt as a kickoff to autumn."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... Top Road-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Doto-chan, thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Maybe I shouldn't really be saying this, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auugh, I mean, umm...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Congratulations~!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It was so amazing, or rather...
Of course, the one I respect the most
is Opera O-san, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san is kind of like a teacher to me as well...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Doto-chan...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm hardly someone worthy of being called a "teacher,"
but if I was able to encourage Doto-chan, that's enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: D-Dotou...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Even with me by your side... you've also been having secret rendezvous with Top Road-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, cursed Rusticana!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-O-Opera O-saaaan!?
No, you've got it all wrong.
I-I-I was just...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
Just a jest, merely a jest.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What could possibly be wrong
with those standing on the same stage opening up to one another?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I was thinking
it was about time anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Opera-chan? What do you mean by the "right moment"...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, just hear me out.
Come on, gather 'round, you too Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, four Umamusume gathered
around TM Opera O—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Don't you all think it is about time
we reexamine the current format of the Revue?
Namely—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No side!
And no border, too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No-border...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It all started when I evolved
so powerfully and beautifully.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To catch up to me, Top Road-san and Ayabe-san
joined forces, honed their skills, and finally reached my domain.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"With Doto joining in, they're currently in opposition.
However――"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Inherently, there are no walls between us.
Isn't that right? Because we are..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Because we're "classmates."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Palpitations...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. A constellation of brilliant stars who shared
the same year beneath the very same sky."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And now, every star shines with equal brilliance.
Your growth has been truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And because we've made it this far,
we should feel free to interact with each other even more.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Like having Top Road-san and Doto
train alongside each other—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even if Ayabe-san and I
get super close!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I really don't like the sound of that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Anyway! Instead of two separate duos, why don't we inspire and sharpen each other as a single quartet?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I think that way allows one to reach greater heights.
And that—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that be the best way
to fire up our generation?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Our... generation...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's remark about their "generation"
caused massive ripples to spread.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, the Golden Generation one year above them was the same...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, Spe-chan! Grass-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You two came to watch, too!
I came to watch with King-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it was, Tsuru-chan!
Yeah, watching races really is a lot of fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Don't be silly. There's no way I came to watch just for fun.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's an inspection. An inspection.
We might end up facing each other sometime this year, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The late-blooming Umamusume of the Golden Generation, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
And King Halo, who proudly holds up her banner of first-class excellence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of this sheer depth of talent, they were called the Golden Generation.
Such free-spirited camaraderie was something
Narita Top Road's generation did not have.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Our next race goes without saying.
The GⅠ Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"So why don't we have a showdown for the lead role there?
The four of us, plus our honored guests from around the world."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquers that race will draw the world's attention
and simultaneously become—
the "King of the Generation."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, Opera O-chan!
Everyone bringing out everything
they've learned so far—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash with all we have!
Everyone is a friend, and everyone is a rival!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two small circles became one big circle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
this turned out to be quite unexpected, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A race where everyone is jumbled together
is a little... nerve-wracking.
choice_data_list: Yeah, yesterday's friend is today's rival.
Yeah, yesterday's friend is today's rival, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Now that I think about it... I might have been
clinging to Ayabe-san a bit too much lately.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We don't need to lean on each other anymore.
They're both strong...! And both of them are..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We're aiming for the top!
After all, only one person can stand at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The friendship between Umamusume is no ordinary friendship.
It shines all the brighter and hotter precisely because they compete against each other.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it! Before standing at the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series—
first, I'll aim for the top of my generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best in the Japan Cup, where Umamusume from all over the world gather!
